summary: Hermes project-plugin opt-in gap: the builder never sets HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS=1, without which the repo plugin (and the read-only marker and spec-folder it wires) is inert per the packet's own statement.

Hermes persona env gap: HERMES_AGENT_PERSONA is never set; the persona section reads only that env and renders empty without it; the native-shaped dispatch needs -s agent-<name> plus the generated mirror.
Claude and OpenCode builders lack the command -v availability probe that the other five builders implement.

Model default divergences: codex builder default o4-mini vs packet gpt-5.5; opencode builder default anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 vs packet opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash; neither validates against a roster.
Codex service tier is only set when explicitly provided while the packet keeps fast by default; the reasoning default literal matches the packet.

Ownership line: env vars, spawn-time decisions, mirrors and model defaults belong in the builder; anything command-string-detectable belongs in the preflight; the read-only marker is the cautionary half-wired example.
Sequencing: persona wiring must follow the exemption fix, otherwise the builder freezes the disproved -s exception; the builder test should assert -s agent-<name> together with --ignore-rules.
